annotations.note: ANNOTATION LAYER (2026-08-31, lib/annotate.js) -- REWORKED same day to fix a measured defect: every text/block below used to carry an ABSOLUTE cx/cy in the hand-drawn reference's own coordinate space, which is not where the placer actually puts anything, so a caption could drift arbitrarily far from what it names (measured: the ANT/50 ohm caption landed ~200px away from P_ANT, in blank canvas). Every text now carries an `anchor` (a component refdes/id, e.g. `P_ANT`, OR a zone `name` from `zones` below, e.g. `pa`) plus a `side` (left/right/top/bottom/center) and a `dx`/`dy` offset in the SAME raw reference-coordinate units as `devices` above (scaled identically at annotate time, so ?seedScale= cannot desync it). annotate.js resolves the anchor's ACTUAL placed geometry from the live model, so a caption is structurally incapable of drifting off the thing it names -- it moves when that thing moves. Every block now carries a `zone` name instead of its own cx/cy/w/h: its rectangle is the UNION of that zone's member components' placed bounding boxes, padded by `pad` -- a box computed from its own members can never enclose the wrong parts.
